payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sort distinct cup volumes to find min, max, optional middle, then compute half-difference and check counts to identify unique pouring source and target.
payload.rationale: The solution sorts the set of volumes to organize min/max/middle, which directly uses sorting as a key step. No sweep line or binary search is used, so sorting_custom_key is the best match among given subtypes, despite the sort key being default.
